title: Choose the visual world for IndicIntentGuard
question: The roll assigned the Banknote Security Print world. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Banknote Security Print
options.lineage: RBI rupee-note security printing: intaglio, guilloche, see-through register
options.thesis: A rupee note is designed so a wrong number cannot pass. The guard borrows that idea.
options.viewport: A light stone-lavender working screen: the transcript set large with words and figures, the B0 and B3 panels side by side, and a transit-style pipeline line across the top.
options.risk: Guilloche used as wallpaper turns into a costume, so it has to appear only in the verification seal.

raised.raise: The pipeline is drawn as one rail line with stations at 45 and 90 degrees, and clarify loops back as an interchange.
When the guard overrides B0, the amount cell flips digit by digit from 30,000 to 13,000.
Every decision sits directly above its evidence, so each claim comes with its proof.
Each evidence item shows its weight as a dot on a fixed magnitude scale instead of a percentage list.

options.label: CTS Cheque Leaf
options.lineage: Indian CTS-2010 bank cheques: amount in words and figures, MICR band, A/c Payee crossing
options.thesis: A cheque asks for the amount twice, in words and in figures. That is exactly the check the guard runs.
options.viewport: Each request is drawn as a cheque leaf: a Rupees-only line for the literal text, a figure box for the ITN digits, and a MICR band carrying the decision.
options.risk: Familiar, and the most likely place any run would land. It can also drift into cream skeuomorphism.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.lineage: metro rail diagrams fired on enamel
options.thesis: The whole speech-to-action pipeline drawn as a metro line you can follow.
options.viewport: A midnight-blue screen with the pipeline as a scarlet line across the top. Each utterance is a train that stops at stations, and the decision is shown at the interchange.
options.case: Wins on showing the pipeline, but the dark ground works against the no-dark-AI-look constraint, and on video the B0-vs-B3 contrast reads second.
options.risk: A dark enamel ground can come across as the glowing dark-dashboard look the brief rules out.

options.label: Concourse Split-flap
options.thesis: The wrong amount flips to the right one, and the whole board reacts.
options.viewport: A departure board where every utterance is a row: B0's amount in one column and the guard's in the next, with the status flaps reading EXECUTED, CONFIRM or HOLD.
options.case: The correction is the most dramatic on video here, but it reads as a novelty board, not a working tool.
options.risk: A black board drifts toward the dark look, and per-character flipping can hurt Telugu text.

options.label: Monochrome Product Canon
options.thesis: A neutral scale with one accent, and every claim followed by its proof.
options.viewport: Claim and proof pairs on a white grid.
options.risk: Nothing about it is Indian, voice, or money. It looks like every other SaaS demo.
options.case: Loses on both audience identification and product clarity.
options.kept: Each decision sits directly above its evidence, so the claim is always next to its proof.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Hierarchy shown through dot size on a fixed magnitude scale.
options.risk: It is abstract, and judges would not connect it to banking speech.
options.kept: Evidence weight is shown as dot size on a fixed scale.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: A visible construction grid as the armature.
options.risk: Grid-built numerals would be hard to read on video.
options.kept: Everything aligns to one strict column grid.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Layered acetate leaves, with depth used as rank.
options.viewport: Decision leaves hinged over a section board.
options.risk: It is nostalgic and buries the comparison.
options.kept: State changes are short stepped transitions, not long fades.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean light dashboard with a card grid and one blue accent, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: A top bar, an input card, and two result cards side by side.
canonCard.risk: It is indistinguishable from any AI demo by design, which is the look you asked to avoid.
